item.title: LiteLLM Compromised, Steals Credentials
item.description: In a new incident, a malicious version (1.107.0) of the LiteLLM package was uploaded to PyPI and Docker on October 21. The malicious version includes a credential stealer targeting browser, cloud and AI secrets as well as a dormant C2 capability.
